description: This file implements the MiracastService plugin for a media device platform. It manages Miracast (Wi-Fi display) functionality including enabling/disabling discovery, handling client connections, updating system state, and interfacing with Thunder plugins via JSON RPC. It also manages power and Wi-Fi state changes and provides internal control logic for the Miracast session lifecycle.

classes.name: MiracastService
classes.description: Main plugin class that manages Miracast session lifecycle, handles RPC methods, and system events.

classes.name: MiracastController
classes.description: Handles lower-level Miracast connection and session management, invoked by MiracastService.

methods.name: setEnableWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to enable or disable Miracast discovery.

methods.name: getEnable
methods.description: RPC method to get current discovery enable state.

methods.name: setP2PBackendDiscovery
methods.description: RPC method to configure P2P backend discovery.

methods.name: acceptClientConnection
methods.description: RPC method to accept or reject a client connection request.

methods.name: stopClientConnection
methods.description: RPC method to stop an ongoing client connection.

methods.name: updatePlayerState
methods.description: RPC method to update the state of the media player.

methods.name: setLogging
methods.description: RPC method to set the logging level.

methods.name: updateSystemFriendlyName
methods.description: Queries and updates the system-friendly name via Thunder RPC.

methods.name: onFriendlyNameUpdateHandler
methods.description: Handles updates to friendly name events.

methods.name: onMiracastServiceClientConnectionRequest
methods.description: Internal callback when a new client connection request is received.

methods.name: onMiracastServiceClientConnectionError
methods.description: Internal callback when a client connection error occurs.

methods.name: changeServiceState
methods.description: Changes internal state of the Miracast service.

methods.name: getCurrentServiceState
methods.description: Returns current state of the Miracast service.
